verdict.rationale: MotherDuck has dedicated pricing and billing docs. They describe a 7-day free trial, a Lite plan with 10 GB of free storage and free monthly compute, per-second billing, and fixed Duckling instance sizes (Pulse through Giga), so the pricing model's structure is documented. However, the evidence shows no actual per-unit rates for compute, storage, or the paid tiers, so a pre-commitment bill estimate isn't shown to be possible. The usage views and billing dashboard only help after the fact. missing for 10: published per-unit compute/storage rates, per-Duckling-size pricing, a cost calculator or worked estimation example, and independent confirmation that bills are predictable.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, the pricing model is documented clearly enough that I can estimate a monthly bill for my workload before committing
